data.title: The local business dilemma
data.markdown:
Local business owners face a bad choice: pay an agency for a static website that grows outdated within weeks, or surrender their customers to aggregators and booking platforms that take a cut of every transaction.

When an owner needs to update holiday hours, rotate a seasonal menu, or post a new workshop slot, they should not have to battle an intimidating dashboard or wait for an agency invoice. That is why KrabiClaw is built around a simple premise: **the day-to-day of your website should be a conversation.** You create the site and connect the domain in the CMS; after that, editing it is a message to Claude or ChatGPT.

steps.text: Sign up and create your site in the CMS. The MCP app works on the sites your account can already manage.

steps.text: In your client's connector or app settings, add a custom MCP server pointing at https://krabiclaw.com/api/mcp. In chats, select KrabiClaw from the tools or apps menu.

data.title: Try a safe first request
data.body:
“List my KrabiClaw sites. Then, for the site called `your site name`, summarize its homepage. Do not change anything.”

Name the site you mean rather than letting the client pick one: a request that says “the first one” leaves the choice to the model, and the wrong site is the one that gets edited.
